placements.why: All six segments are facets of one ongoing subject — which database backs the analytics pipeline, why (quantified columnar-query performance), and when the cutover happens — restated once in prose (src-1/2/3) and once in bold-label summary form (src-4/5/6). Per the narrative grain test this passes: 'analytics infrastructure adoption, justified and scheduled' is a subject future envelopes (progress updates, benchmark revisits, timeline slips) will keep feeding, not a one-time fact. The 15x figure and the Q3 2026 date are evidence/commitments supporting this theme rather than leaves of their own (rule 2) — minting separate leaves for the measurement or the date would be the sprawl failure mode this pass is built against. No existing leaf was supplied to reuse, so this is a NEW mint under the freshly minted Architecture strata.
